scripts.features:
Main Features
- Auto-Farm: Automatically finds and attacks Brainrots.
    - Target Priority: Set target priority based on "Rarity" or "Max Health".
    - Movement Mode: Choose between "Teleport" or "Walk" to move to targets.
    - Rarity Filter: Exclude specific rarities from being targeted.

Plot Management
- Auto-Buy Platforms: Continuously purchases available platforms on your plot.
- Auto-Buy Rows: Automatically buys all available plot rows.
- Clear Plot: A button to delete all items placed on your plot.

Inventory & Selling
- Manual Sell: Buttons to sell your currently held item or all items in your inventory instantly.
- Worth Checker (Stable): Accurately checks the in-game value of your held item or calculates the total worth of all items in your backpack. Provides real-time status updates.

Automation & Utility
- Auto-Rebirth: Performs rebirth automatically at a configured interval.
- Auto-Equip Best: Periodically equips the best Brainrots you own.
- Auto-Favorite:
    - Select specific rarities to target.
    - Automatically favorites any new items that match the selected rarities.
    - Option to scan and favorite all existing items in your backpack.

Trade Hub (Refined)
- Auto-Accept Gifts: Automatically accepts all incoming gifts from any player.
- Auto-Gift System:
    - Select a target player from a dynamic list.
    - Choose specific items from a pre-defined list to auto-gift.
    - The script will automatically gift these items to the target player as soon as they enter your backpack.
- Manual Gifting: Manually select a player and an item from your backpack to send a gift.
- Live Player/Item Lists: Refresh the player and backpack lists at any time to ensure they are up-to-date.

Auto-Shopping
- Auto-Buy Seeds: Select multiple seed types to purchase once or continuously at a set interval.
- Auto-Buy Gear: Select multiple gear items to purchase once or continuously at a set interval.

Performance & Utility
- Performance Mode: Disables rendering and hides UI elements to significantly improve frame rates.
- Anti-AFK: Prevents the game from disconnecting you for being idle.
- Auto-Reconnect: Automatically rejoins the server if you are disconnected.
- FPS Limiter: Set a custom FPS cap to control performance.

UI & Settings
- UI Toggles: Open or close the in-game "Gears" and "Seeds" menus directly from the script.
- Config Saving: Your settings are saved automatically for your next session.

Info & Feedback
- Credits: Displays the script author and community links.
- Rate & Report: A built-in system to rate the script and report bugs directly to the developer.
